description: Turn a target allocation into a concrete order list — dollar and share deltas per name, a tax tag per row, and an optional schedule that stages the buys over N trading days. Use when someone has decided what they want to own and needs the actual orders, when trimming a concentrated position, when deploying cash, or when asked "what do I actually type into the broker". Produces a list; never an order.
